verdict.rationale: Quo documents a REST API with JSON responses, API keys, and rate limits, but nothing in the evidence offers a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are related AI-facing features, not an API spec, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
